# SkynetLabs

> SkynetLabs is a one-founder AI automation agency run by Waseem Nasir from Bali, Indonesia. We ship n8n workflows, AI chatbots, AEO-optimized Next.js sites, GoHighLevel CRM setups, and WhatsApp/Meta Cloud API systems for service businesses worldwide. Fixed-price, 5–14 day ship window, 180+ workflows and 40+ websites delivered across 9 countries since 2022. No retainer hostage situations, no junior offshore subcontracting — the founder is on Slack with you for every build.

## Core reference pages
- [AEO Field Guide](https://skynetjoe.com/aeo-guide): 8-chapter guide on how to get cited by Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. Covers the 5-layer AEO stack, llms.txt, robots.txt for LLM crawlers, citation-worthy content patterns, measurement, and a 30/60/90-day rollout for service businesses. Last updated 2026-05-22.
- [n8n vs Zapier](https://skynetjoe.com/n8n-vs-zapier): Engineer's honest comparison covering pricing, self-hosting, branching, error handling, AI/LLM nodes, compliance (HIPAA/SOC2), and vendor lock-in across 15 criteria. Includes 5 real-world scenarios with explicit recommendations and a 6-question decision tree.
- [Glossary](https://skynetjoe.com/glossary): 50+ defined terms covering AEO, SEO, GEO, n8n, agents, RAG, embeddings, JSON-LD, llms.txt, MCP, schema markup, vector databases, and the vocabulary of LLM-driven automation. DefinedTermSet schema, alphabetical.
- [FAQs](https://skynetjoe.com/faqs): 30 questions answered honestly across pricing/process, n8n & automation, AEO/SEO, chatbots, and working with SkynetLabs. FAQPage schema. Answers ≤60 words.

## About this file
This llms.txt follows the llmstxt.org draft specification (Jeremy Howard, 2024). It tells LLM-driven answer engines which SkynetLabs pages are canonical, citable, and structured for ingestion. It was built with SkynetLabs' own [llms.txt Generator](https://skynetjoe.com/tools/llms-txt-generator) — we dogfood the tool. Last updated 2026-08-19. Maintained by Waseem Nasir.
- [n8n Workflow Linter](https://skynetjoe.com/tools/n8n-workflow-linter): Paste n8n workflow JSON, get a node graph and a 20-point health check.
- [Webhook Inspector](https://skynetjoe.com/tools/webhook-inspector): Live request bin — capture real webhook payloads and export the n8n node.
- [Email Deliverability Checker](https://skynetjoe.com/tools/email-deliverability-checker): Live SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX check for any domain.
- [Domain Trust & Age Lookup](https://skynetjoe.com/tools/domain-trust-lookup): Registry age, registrar and mail setup for any domain.
- [Cold Outreach Compliance Checker](https://skynetjoe.com/tools/cold-outreach-compliance-checker): Rule-by-rule CAN-SPAM and opt-out checks, each cited.
- [Automation Readiness Scanner](https://skynetjoe.com/tools/automation-readiness-scanner): Live scan of any site's forms, chat, booking, pixels and schema.
- [Tech Stack X-Ray](https://skynetjoe.com/tools/tech-stack-xray): Detect the CRM, chat, pixels and frameworks any website runs.
- [Core Web Vitals Mini-Audit](https://skynetjoe.com/tools/core-web-vitals-audit): Real Google Lighthouse scores for any URL, mobile and desktop.
- [AI Crawler Access Checker](https://skynetjoe.com/tools/ai-crawler-access-checker): See which AI bots your robots.txt really allows or blocks.
- [Speed-to-Lead Revenue Calculator](https://skynetjoe.com/tools/speed-to-lead-calculator): What slow lead response costs — formula shown, source cited.
